name: nutrihelp-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server for NutriHelp

scripts.test:controls: vitest run test/security/egress.test.ts && vitest run test/security/upstreamMock.test.ts && vitest run test/security/compositionRoot.test.ts
scripts.coverage:auth: vitest run --coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json-summary --exclude test/security/auth/revocation.test.ts --exclude test/security/consent/confirmation.test.ts --exclude test/security/shape/bound.test.ts --exclude test/security/tools/registry.test.ts --exclude test/security/upstream/client.test.ts && node -e "const P=require('path');const s=require('./coverage/coverage-summary.json');const f=Object.keys(s).filter(k=>k!=='total').filter(k=>P.relative(process.cwd(),k).split(P.sep).join('/').startsWith('src/auth/'));const t=f.reduce((n,k)=>n+s[k].branches.total,0);const c=f.reduce((n,k)=>n+s[k].branches.covered,0);if(f.length===0){console.error('coverage:auth measured no file under src/auth/ - refusing to read that as a pass');process.exit(1);}if(t===0){console.error('coverage:auth measured 0 branches under src/auth/ - refusing to read that as a pass');process.exit(1);}console.log('coverage:auth: src/auth/** branches ' + c + '/' + t + ' over ' + f.length + ' files, scope = full test glob minus the 5 red-by-design security files');"
scripts.validate: npm run check:node && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run conformance && npm run test:controls && npm run security:audit
